title: Elementa — Silver Palace Sets Global Launch Date for December 14, 2026
facts: Global launch announced for 14 December 2026 (UTC+8); no opening hour specified.
Announced platforms: PC, PlayStation 5, iOS and Android.
Twelve text languages announced; this does not establish regional player shares.
Detective investigations, open-world exploration and real-time character switching are described.
limitations: Announcement, not a live-service verification. Confirm region-specific availability and opening times on official channels. No numerical progression data established.
assets: Factual reference only. No third-party images or article prose copied.
